cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(UAA_MapEditor VERSION 0.1.4 LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
find_package(SDL2 2.0.18 REQUIRED)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_executable(uaa-mapeditor src/main.cpp)
target_include_directories(uaa-mapeditor PRIVATE vendor ${SDL2_INCLUDE_DIRS})
if(TARGET SDL2::SDL2)
 target_link_libraries(uaa-mapeditor PRIVATE SDL2::SDL2 Threads::Threads)
else()
 target_link_libraries(uaa-mapeditor PRIVATE ${SDL2_LIBRARIES} Threads::Threads)
endif()
if(WIN32)
 target_link_libraries(uaa-mapeditor PRIVATE comdlg32)
 if(MINGW)
  target_link_options(uaa-mapeditor PRIVATE -Wl,--subsystem,windows)
 elseif(MSVC)
  target_link_options(uaa-mapeditor PRIVATE /SUBSYSTEM:WINDOWS /ENTRY:mainCRTStartup)
 endif()
endif()
add_executable(uaa-core-tests tests/core_tests.cpp)
target_include_directories(uaa-core-tests PRIVATE src vendor)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME core COMMAND uaa-core-tests)
install(TARGETS uaa-mapeditor RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)

install(FILES LICENSE LICENSING.md MUSIC-LICENSE.txt README.md DESTINATION share/doc/uaa-mapeditor)
install(DIRECTORY LICENSES DESTINATION share/doc/uaa-mapeditor)
